system.description: Each level teaches one malediction (of eight — full text in the spell list). Maledictions follow spell rules but cost Hit Points, use (MIG + WLP) offensively, and are lifted by filling a negotiated 4-section Clock. Harm is retyped to dark; Reanimate raises one corpse at a time.
